# `openinference` attributes

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="openinference-project-name" href="#openinference-project-name">`openinference.project.name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The name of the project that the telemetry belongs to. [1] | `default`, `my-llm-app` |
| <a id="openinference-span-kind" href="#openinference-span-kind">`openinference.span.kind`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string (well-known values) | The role an operation plays in an AI application. [2] |  |

**[1] `openinference.project.name`:** Recorded as a resource attribute, not a span attribute. Identifies the `openinference.project` entity.

**[2] `openinference.span.kind`:** Required on every OpenInference span. It is distinct from OpenTelemetry's own `SpanKind`.
See [Span Kinds](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/general/span-kinds.md).


---

`openinference.span.kind` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LLM` | A call to a large language model. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `CHAIN` | A link between application steps, or the start of a request. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `TOOL` | Execution of a tool or function. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `RETRIEVER` | A query to a vector store, search engine, or database. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `RERANKER` | Reordering of candidate documents by relevance. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `EMBEDDING` | Generation of vector embeddings. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `AGENT` | A reasoning step that acts on tools using an LLM's guidance. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `GUARDRAIL` | An input or output moderation check. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `EVALUATOR` | An evaluation of a model's output. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `PROMPT` | The rendering of a prompt template. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `DECISION` | A call to a decision model. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `UNKNOWN` | Fallback used by SDKs when the kind of an operation cannot be determined. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
